original_text: <!-- (audio) James: If we find critical bugs, we'll probably have to roll back the deployment and fix them before trying again. It might delay the release, but it's better than having a broken product.-->
translated_text: <!-- (audio) James: Ako pronađemo kritične bugove, verovatno ćemo morati da vratimo deploaj i popravimo ih pre nego što pokušamo ponovo. To bi moglo odložiti izdanje, ali je bolje nego imati pokvaren proizvod.-->
